title: Generative AI Produces and Transmits Beauty Bias
title_zh: 生成式AI产生并传播美貌偏见

paragraphs.en: 研究审计27个文生图模型发现，生成式AI放大了美貌偏见，存在种族与性别刻板印象，并影响现实中人的被评价结果。 Societies reward people judged to be attractive by standards intertwined with gender and race. In this paper, we examine if and how generative AI may contribute to these dynamics. We audited 27 text-to-image generators released between 2022 and 2026 using simple prompts that never mention attractiveness or beauty, analyzing 51,300 generated faces and 160,196 photographs of real people across primary and supplementary comparisons. We used three automated measures and collected ratings from 550 human raters on a subset of images. Nearly all generators produced faces scoring above photographed faces under automated measures, and human raters judged the outputs of all 23 generators as significantly more attractive than photographed faces, even after correction for multiple comparisons. When focusing our analysis on gender, we find that 37% of female-prompted generated faces outscored the median professional fashion model. Across racial, ethnic, and national categories, groups associated with darker skin tones tended to receive lower attractiveness scores than groups associated with lighter skin tones. In a preregistered hiring simulation experiment (N = 570), exposure to AI-generated faces selected for high human-rated attractiveness lowered hireability and trustworthiness ratings and reduced interview advancement for an identical test set of candidates paired with photographs of real people; exposure to retouched photographs produced no such effect. Generative AI can reproduce racial hierarchies and gendered patterns of beauty and alter the context in which real people are judged.
paragraphs.zh: 研究审计27个文生图模型发现，生成式AI放大了美貌偏见，存在种族与性别刻板印象，并影响现实中人的被评价结果。 社会以与性别和种族交织在一起的标准来奖励被判定为有吸引力的人。 在本文中，我们检验生成式AI是否以及如何助长这些动态。 我们审计了2022年至2026年间发布的27个文生图生成器，使用从未提及吸引力或美貌的简单提示词，在主要与补充性比较中分析了51,300张生成的人脸和160,196张真实人物照片。 我们使用了三种自动化测量方法，并收集了550名人类评分者对部分图像的评分。 在自动化测量下，几乎所有生成器生成的人脸得分都高于照片中的人脸，即使经过多重比较校正后，人类评分者仍认为全部23个生成器的输出显著比照片中的人脸更有吸引力。 当我们聚焦性别进行分析时，发现37%以女性为提示生成的人脸得分超过了职业时装模特的中位数。 在种族、族裔和国籍类别中，与较深肤色相关联的群体往往比与较浅肤色相关联的群体获得更低的吸引力评分。 在一项预注册的招聘模拟实验（N = 570）中，接触经筛选具有高人类吸引力评分的AI生成人脸，会降低与真实人物照片配对的同一测试集候选人的可雇佣性和可信度评分，并减少其获得面试机会；而接触经修饰的照片则不产生这种效应。 生成式AI能够再现种族等级制度和性别化的美貌模式，并改变评价真实人物的情境。
